description:
Minit SDK for Defold
Integrate your Defold game with the Minit Games platform. Minit runs HTML5 games inside a mobile app WebView and on shareable play pages. This SDK is the thin Lua facade your game calls to talk to the Minit host: reveal the game when it's ready, report results, read per-game config, and persist player save data.
name: Minit SDK

releases.message:
The Minit Games Defold SDK now ships the packaging tooling and the HTML host shell, so a project only needs the dependency.

**Install** — add this dependency URL under `[project] dependencies` in your `game.project`, then **Project → Fetch Libraries**:

```
https://github.com/Minit-Games/minit-defold/archive/refs/tags/v0.2.0.zip
```

Then `require("minit.minit")` and call `minit.loading_done()`, `minit.report_result(...)`, `minit.get_config_value(...)`, `minit.get_user_data()`.

New in 0.2.0:
- **Project → Minit: Package for Upload** menu item, from the library: checks `meta.json` and the title, bundles a release HTML5 build, and writes `dist/<title>.zip` ready for minit.studio.
- Minit HTML host shell (with the audio repair) as a library file: set `[html5] htmlfile = /minit/minit.html`. The old `example/minit.html` is removed.
- Licence notices for Defold 1.13.1 and its HTML5 third-party components ship with the library and go into the ZIP; your own `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` is appended when present.

Upgrading from 0.1.0: delete the old `editor/minit.editor_script` and `editor/minit_package.lua` copies, and remove the Defold/SDK sections from an old `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`.

See the README for the API, the packaging steps, and the `example/` sample.
